name: Esp32 Ble Tracker → On Ble Advertise
description:
An automation to perform when a Bluetooth advertising is received. See [`on_ble_advertise` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_tracker/#esp32_ble_tracker-on_ble_advertise).

This automation will be triggered when a Bluetooth advertising is received. A variable `x` of type <APIClass text="esp32_ble_tracker::ESPBTDevice" path="esp32_ble_tracker::ESPBTDevice" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas.

config_entries.label: MAC Address
config_entries.description: The MAC address to filter for this automation.
